meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Nebula: hides sign-up pitches and the autoplay trailer, blurs or hides artwork, can hide Originals, creator sections and footer
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out, headless Chrome, https://nebula.tv/ with an iPhone UA and a desktop UA (one responsive page; both captures had the same 9 sections). Nebula is a React app with hashed `css-xxxx` classes (not used); selectors rely on ids, `href` values and the `data-section-label` attribute.

- **Sign-up pitches**: `a[href="/join"]` 3 (header Sign up plus hero and closing buttons) and the Why Subscribe, Testimonials, What Creators Say and Sign up blocks (LIVE). The Sign in link (`/login`) is never hidden.
- **Autoplay trailer**: `main video[aria-hidden="true"]` 1 (LIVE).
- **Artwork**: `main img` 153 and `main picture` 106 (LIVE).
- **Originals** 2 sections, **creator sections** 3 sections, **footer** `footer#app-footer` 1 (LIVE).

`data-section-label` values are English marketing headings, so those rules only match the English site and may break when Nebula edits its copy. Not verified: the logged-in library, video pages, channel pages, the player, search. Nothing was hidden for cookies (no consent banner rendered).
